text: Triangles which are on the same base and between the same parallels are equal to one another.    Let $ABC$ and $DBC$ be triangles on the same base $BC$, and between the same parallels $AD$ and $BC$. I say that triangle $ABC$ is equal to triangle $DBC$.
Let $AD$ have been produced in both directions to $E$ and $F$,
and let the (straight-line) $BE$ have been drawn through $B$ parallel to $CA$ [Prop.~1.31],
and let the (straight-line) $CF$ have been drawn through $C$ parallel to $BD$ [Prop.~1.31].

assertion: EBCA and DBCF are both parallelograms

text: and are equal. For they are on the same base $BC$, and between the same parallels $BC$ and $EF$ [Prop.~1.35].

spans.label: assumption
spans.text: they are on the same base $BC$, and between the same parallels $BC$ and $EF$

text: And the triangle $ABC$ is half of  the parallelogram $EBCA$. For the diagonal $AB$ cuts the latter in half [Prop.~1.34].
assertion: triangle ABC is half of parallelogram EBCA

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: the triangle $ABC$ is half of  the parallelogram $EBCA$

spans.label: glue
spans.text: . For the diagonal $AB$ cuts the latter in half [Prop.~1.34].

text: And the  triangle $DBC$ (is) half of the parallelogram $DBCF$. For the diagonal $DC$ cuts the latter in half [Prop.~1.34].
assertion: triangle DBC is half of parallelogram DBCF

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: the  triangle $DBC$ (is) half of the parallelogram $DBCF$

spans.label: glue
spans.text: . For the diagonal $DC$ cuts the latter in half [Prop.~1.34].

text: [And the halves of equal things are equal to one another.]
assertion: halves of equal things are equal to one another

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: [And the halves of equal things are equal to one another.]

text: Thus, triangle $ABC$ is equal to triangle $DBC$.
assertion: triangle ABC is equal to triangle DBC

text: Thus, triangles which are on the same base and between the same parallels are equal to one another. (Which is) the very thing it was required to show.
